oci.desc: Configuration and monitoring of OCI/cXML interfaces for SAP and other ERP systems.

oci.ociProtocolDesc: SAP standard for punch-out catalogues. The ERP sends a POST request with HOOK_URL, the user selects articles and the cart is returned via HTML form.
oci.cxmlProtocolDesc: XML-based standard for procurement messages. Supports PunchOutSetupRequest, PunchOutOrderMessage and OrderRequest.

oci.sapStep1: Create a new external catalogue (Transaction: ME_NEW_CAT or Ariba Catalog)
oci.sapStep3: Enter OCI Setup URL as punch-out URL
oci.sapStep4: Transfer parameters: HOOK_URL = SAP return URL

oci.title: OCI Punch-Out & SAP Integration
oci.desc: OCI (Open Catalog Interface) enables direct integration with SAP and other ERP systems.
oci.what: What is OCI? A standard protocol that transfers articles from external catalogues directly into the SAP shopping cart.
oci.step1: ERP system starts OCI session (automatically via URL parameter)
oci.step2: You search and select articles in the application
oci.step3: Click "Add to Cart" for each desired article
oci.step4: Review the cart in the blue banner at the top
oci.step5: Click "Send Cart" — articles are automatically transferred to SAP
oci.warning: The OCI session has a limited validity period. When expired, you must restart the session in your ERP system.
oci.cxml: cXML (Commerce XML) is additionally supported for systems that prefer this format.
oci.sapConnection: The SAP connection is displayed and monitored under Administration → Connections.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What happens when the AI is unavailable?
faq.a1: The application automatically switches to rule-based classification. All features remain usable.
faq.q2: How do I access the admin area?
faq.a2: Click "Administration" in the top navigation or navigate directly to /admin.
faq.q3: Can I compare articles from different marketplaces?
faq.a3: Yes! Select up to 3 articles from different sources and use the price comparison.
faq.q4: How does the SAP integration work?
faq.a4: Via the OCI protocol. Your SAP system starts a punch-out session, you select articles, and they are automatically transferred back to SAP.
faq.q5: Where can I find the CSV export?
faq.a5: In the admin area under Orders (download button in the top right) and in the price comparison.
